changeSummary: Adds per-card variety metadata (silhouetteClass, poseEnergy, accent) and revises a handful of poses/palettes to reduce silhouette, pose-energy, and palette clustering identified in docs/silhouette-and-variety-review.md. Core anatomy and tarot rules are unchanged.
coreRule: All subjects must remain anatomically bird. Streetwear adapts to bird anatomy and must not create humanoid bodies.

style.composition: vertical tarot card with ornate border, full-body bird subject, readable title area

varietyLevers.silhouetteClass: Body-plan group used to check shape-clash at card scale.
varietyLevers.poseEnergy: static | active | dynamic. Target deck mix ~9 / ~8 / ~5.
varietyLevers.accent: The single distinguishing hue that keeps same-family cards apart.

cards.description: A small, scrappy traveler with bright eyes and restless energy.
cards.pose: Airborne mid-leap off a rooftop edge or curb, wings just opening, feet still trailing the ledge.
cards.varietyNotes: Songbird quartet: separated by being the only airborne small bird. Commit the leap so it never reads as a static perch like the Nuthatch.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A starter card about exploration, leap-of-faith movement, and lucky mistakes.

cards.description: A sharp-eyed collector surrounded by symbolic tools and shiny found objects.
cards.pose: Perched over arranged objects with one wing naturally extended toward them.
cards.varietyNotes: Corvid pair with the Devil's Raven: hold the strong black/white pied contrast and tool clutter so it never reads as the all-black Raven.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about converting resources, creating combos, and manipulating tools.

cards.description: A silent watcher framed by moon symbols and secret thresholds.
cards.pose: Tight head-and-shoulders crop, still, head slightly turned, heart-shaped face catching light.
cards.varietyNotes: Owl pair with the Hermit: this one is a TIGHT crop on a dark veil field, heart-face forward. Aged gold accent separates it from the cool-blue mystical cluster.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about secrets, prediction, concealed paths, and intuition checks.

cards.description: An elegant swan surrounded by lush growth and soft city-water reflections.
cards.pose: Graceful floating or seated water pose with curved neck.
cards.varietyNotes: Distinctive silhouette already (large S-neck waterfowl). No clash.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about growth, healing, summons, and abundance engines.

cards.description: A commanding raptor with a monumental silhouette and disciplined visual language.
cards.pose: Monumental high perch, wings folded tight, chest squared, gaze level and forward.
cards.varietyNotes: Raptor cluster: stays the heavy, square, monumental one. Contrast with the Falcon's lean diving line.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about defense, command effects, formation bonuses, and rules.

cards.description: A ritual teacher bridging old symbols and street-temple culture.
cards.pose: Calm standing pose, long neck fully vertical, wings relaxed.
cards.varietyNotes: Wader cluster: the vertical, neutral-gray one. Verticality + sand palette separate it from the Stilt (thin/monochrome) and Flamingo (curved/pink).
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about rulesets, rituals, training, and shared buffs.

cards.description: Two natural birds in balanced relationship, not fused or humanoid.
cards.pose: Mirrored perch or gentle flight around a shared symbol.
cards.varietyNotes: Two-subject composition is itself a unique silhouette in the deck. No clash.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about bonds, paired actions, commitment choices, and synergy.

cards.description: A sleek falcon slicing through city wind with total intent.
cards.pose: Committed stoop/dive, wings swept tight to the body, motion lines trailing.
cards.varietyNotes: Raptor cluster: the only diving raptor. The lean swept-wing teardrop shape is its whole differentiation from the Emperor.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about charge attacks, momentum, pursuit, and victory conditions.

cards.description: A tall, composed hunter whose strength is restraint.
cards.pose: Mid restrained stomp — one long leg raised in its natural striking kick, expression calm, energy contained not wild.
cards.varietyNotes: Wader cluster: the crest + raised-leg action pose sets it apart from the calm Crane/Stilt/Flamingo. The kick sells 'controlled power' literally.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about restraint, counterattacks, courage, and taming hostile effects.

cards.description: A pale owl carrying quiet light through cold urban night.
cards.pose: Full-body, alone on a high perch, round white mass, head turned toward a single lantern charm.
cards.varietyNotes: Owl pair with the High Priestess: this one is FULL-BODY, bright round white mass on dark, vs her tight dark-veiled crop. The single warm amber light breaks it out of the cool-blue cluster.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about scouting, retreat, pathfinding, and wisdom gained in isolation.

cards.description: A bright bird caught at the instant fortune turns.
cards.pose: Committed plunge-dive, wings back, beak down, breaking a circular water/coin motif.
cards.varietyNotes: Vivid turquoise-orange contrast + dive pose make it unmistakable. No clash.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about random events, rerolls, turn cycles, and opportunity windows.

cards.description: A precise, symmetrical wading bird balanced between opposing signs.
cards.pose: Still, perfectly symmetrical shallow-water stance on ultra-thin long legs.
cards.varietyNotes: Wader cluster: the thinnest, most symmetrical, monochrome one. Lean on the needle-thin legs and mirror symmetry to separate from Crane/Flamingo.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about consequences, parity, damage reflection, and fair trades.

cards.description: A natural upside-down bird turning inversion into calm insight.
cards.pose: Naturally upside-down on a branch, sign edge, or in peaceful levitation.
cards.varietyNotes: Songbird quartet: the only inverted subject in the whole deck. That alone separates it from Sparrow/Fairywren/Goldfinch.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about reversing perspective, delaying action, trading movement for insight, or flipping board state.

cards.description: A solemn carrion bird representing cleanup, transition, and necessary endings.
cards.pose: Hunched grounded stance OR slow wide-winged circling against a pale dawn.
cards.varietyNotes: Dark-body card: never share a flat-black field with the Devil's Raven. The rust + pale-dawn warmth is its separator.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about sacrifice, clearing old effects, transformation, and rebirth triggers.

cards.description: A graceful balancing bird mixing colors, water, and opposing forces.
cards.pose: Natural one-leg stance, neck curved into a soft S, mixing two water colors below.
cards.varietyNotes: Wader cluster: the pink, curved, one-leg one. Color does most of the separation work here.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about blending resources, healing over time, moderation, and stabilizing extremes.

cards.description: A darkly stylish raven surrounded by broken chains and tempting objects.
cards.pose: Low coiled perch, alert eyes, glossy feathers, sparse and luxe.
cards.varietyNotes: Corvid pair with the Magician: stays all-black, sparse, luxe. Oil-slick purple sheen + hot red separate it from both the Magpie (pied) and the Vulture (rust).
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about bargains, risk-reward power, curses, and attachment mechanics.

cards.description: A sharp bird tied to impact, alarm, and sudden structural change.
cards.pose: Clinging through impact on a cracking signpost mid-hammer, sparks and debris flying.
cards.varietyNotes: Vertical clinging pose + impact FX are unique in the deck. No clash.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about breaking defenses, destroying structures, and forced revelation.

cards.description: A tiny luminous bird beneath a huge sky, gentle but radiant.
cards.pose: Tiny subject low in frame, dwarfed by a vast star-filled sky, hovering lightly near water.
cards.varietyNotes: Songbird quartet: separated by SCALE — smallest subject in the deck, huge negative-space sky. Soft-rose dawn-of-hope accent lifts it out of the cool-blue cluster.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about healing, hope counters, inspiration, and recovery after loss.

cards.description: A camouflaged night bird nearly hidden in surreal moonlight.
cards.pose: Low to the ground, almost dissolving into bark/asphalt camouflage, wide reflective eyes.
cards.varietyNotes: Broken/low-contrast silhouette (intentionally hard to read = the illusion theme) is unique. The sickly muted-green moonlight separates it from the other cool cards.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about hidden information, dreams, illusions, and instinctive navigation.

cards.description: A bright gold bird bursting with clear morning energy.
cards.pose: Open-wing flight in full sunlight, wings spread wide and flat to the viewer.
cards.varietyNotes: Songbird quartet: the only spread-wing frontal flight. Bright saturated yellow + open silhouette separate it cleanly from Sparrow/Nuthatch/Fairywren.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about clarity, success chains, radiant buffs, and removing fear.

cards.description: A bold herald whose cry wakes the whole scene.
cards.pose: Full open-wing crow, head thrown back and up, chest out, loud and theatrical.
cards.varietyNotes: Heavy-bodied galliform with comb/wattle + open-wing crow is unique. No clash.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about awakening units, resolving delayed effects, summons, and public reckoning.

cards.description: A long-distance traveler framed by circular migration and world symbols.
cards.pose: Elegant level flight through a wreath-like circular frame, wings fully extended.
cards.varietyNotes: Sharp-winged seabird inside a circular wreath frame is unique. Aurora green is its differentiator within the cool family — lean into it.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A card about completion, global movement, final synergy, and journey rewards.
